BiblicalUsage: Kaphiyc is a girder — the beam or rafter of a house. Habakkuk says the stone shall cry out of the wall, and the beam out of the timber shall answer it, against the man who builds his house with blood and iniquity.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that even the beams bear witness: a house built on blood cries out against its builder, and no timber is silent before God.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
